en.html:
As though strength were leaking out through every pore. As though somebody had taken my heart and was squeezing it dry.

...Bad. If I let this feeling fill me, that would be the end.
Down and down I would go. No coming back.


...Not yet.


Not yet. Permission for that had NOT been given!
My duty was unfinished. My punishment was still pending!

ja.html:
皮膚の毛穴から活力が抜け出てゆくような感覚。
　心臓を絞られているようでもある脱力感。

　……まずい。
　この感覚に満たされてしまえば、きっと終わりだ。

　何処までも沈んでゆき、二度と戻らぬに違いない。
　

　……まだだ。


　まだ……<ruby>それ<rt>・・</rt></ruby>は許されない！
　俺は役目を果たし終えず、罰せられてもいないのだ！

en.html:
I patched my nearly broken consciousness together and made it stay in the real world. That small achievement consumed most of the strength I had left. Still too early to start reciting complaints.

The enemy would be on me any moment! Forget a counterattack. At least get ready to defend...

en.html:
Only the metal-echo still reaching me kept singing its eagerness to fight. Words had gone, but the murderous intent was perfectly clear. No translation difficulty there.

Yet the machine was dropping. Glaring at me, stretching out a hand, even seeming to struggle—all useless. Gravity was taking it down.

No obvious damage on the demon-shaped dragoon. Wings intact. Barrels intact.
Then... why?

ja.html:
届く<ruby>装甲通信<rt>メタルエコー</rt></ruby>だけは、なお俺への闘志を唄っていた。
　凝縮された殺戮欲の渦は、言語の形を喪失していて
さえ誤解の余地がない。

　しかし、その騎体は落ちてゆく。
　俺を睨み、手を伸ばし、足掻くような仕草すら見せ
ながら――全ては虚しく。重力に引き下ろされてゆく。

　悪魔の姿の竜騎兵に、目立った損傷はない。
　<ruby>翼甲<rt>ウイング</rt></ruby>も<ruby>気筒<rt>バレル</rt></ruby>も無事だ。

　なのに……何故？

en.html:
I watched the enemy grow smaller and farther away. Not quite falling; just barely gliding. But at considerable speed. Land like that, and the damage would be severe.
Even if the thick armour saved the life inside... serious injury could hardly be avoided.

............Brought down by its own doing. This was where it had ended.

小さく、遠くなる敵影を見送る。
　<ruby>墜落<rt>・・</rt></ruby>ではなく、辛うじて<ruby>滑空<rt>・・</rt></ruby>だが――かなりの速度
だ。あのまま着陸すれば相当な被害を<ruby>蒙<rt>こうむ</rt></ruby>るだろう。

　分厚い甲鉄に守られ、死ぬ事はないとしても……
　重傷は避けられまい。

　…………自滅の結末。

en.html:
Something remained stuck inside me, undigested. I turned away with it still there. Whatever else, the obstacle was gone.

Kenchouji. Hurry. This unforeseen business had eaten up my time. Since Kanae's call, how much had already gone?
Whatever was happening, let me not be too late. Bas, not too late...
Let the Prince and the Chief... be safe...

ja.html:
心中に消化不良を残しつつ、俺は身を翻した。
　とにかく――障害は除かれたのだ。

　建朝寺へ急ごう。
　思わぬ異変に時間を蕩尽してしまった。香奈枝嬢の
電話から、既にどれだけ経ったか。

　何事が起きているにせよ、手遅れでなければ良いの
だが……。
　親王と署長が……無事であれば……。
